values.summary: Execute the smallest proving validation DAG.

lanes.proof_role: Prove production Guardian initialization, supervised-kernel private-session readiness, durable channel restart/certificate succession, public-route absence, sealed #210 client ports, and the client half of the exact ordered fifty-six-case denominator, sixty-four boundary subassertions, and twelve cleanup/expiry/cancel/restart/activation lifecycle subassertions.
lanes.defer_reason: Deferred until #191 merges and the complete production client target exists; fail closed on missing target, zero tests, library-only reachability, generic/caller-constructible ports, or any missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, nonpassing case/result/marker/boundary/lifecycle subassertion.

lanes.proof_role: After the Guardian lane, prove production kernel startup, live-participant quiesce/export and rollback, isolated validation/discard, cleanup survival through expiry/cancel/restart, #204-only activation decisions, #208 activation effects and exact-retry receipts, activated-stage discard denial, filesystem/bounds safety, and the server half of the exact ordered fifty-six cases plus sixty-four boundary and twelve lifecycle subassertions.
lanes.defer_reason: Deferred until the private listener, participant registry, sealed ports, and focused kernel target exist; fail closed on synthetic participants, caller descriptors, expired cleanup authority, missing activation receipt, activated-stage discard success, zero tests, or case/map parity drift.

lanes.proof_role: After both focused tests, reject warnings and API misuse across the Runtime library, Guardian production binary, client integration test, and sealed #210 client projections.
lanes.defer_reason: Deferred until the owned Runtime targets exist; fail closed on warnings, missing target, or missing production source.

lanes.proof_role: After Runtime Clippy, reject warnings and API misuse across the kernel library, production kernel binary, integration test, expected-descriptor verifier, persistent cleanup permit, activation effect, and receipt surface.
lanes.defer_reason: Deferred until the owned kernel targets exist; fail closed on warnings, missing target, or missing production source.

lanes.proof_role: After all source-changing validation, load the recorded execution base and proving source revisions, require both exact Git objects and base ancestry, and run diff whitespace/EOF hygiene over the complete base..source range plus reject dirty protected paths.
lanes.defer_reason: Deferred until implementation records exact execution_base_revision and proving_source_revision and creates the verifier; fail closed on absent/non-object revisions, nonancestry, any base..source whitespace or EOF diagnostic, dirty protected source, or working-tree-only evidence.

lanes.proof_role: After tests, both Clippy packages and exact-range diff hygiene pass, require every canonical ordered case to emit a canonical assertion-bound behavioral receipt with durable witness digests, preserve exact fifty-six-case, sixty-four-boundary, and twelve-lifecycle parity, bind current HEAD and current origin/main ancestry, and fail on any LEAK marker.
lanes.defer_reason: Deferred until prior serial lanes pass and the exact producer exists; fail closed on dirty source, stale main ancestry, noncanonical or assertion-free receipts, missing durable witnesses, map parity drift, LEAK, or nonzero status.

lanes.proof_role: Only after producer completion and a distinct fresh exact-head review, independently validate current HEAD/current-main ancestry, fresh canonical behavior receipts and durable witnesses, exact protected source and argv, exact 56/64/12 parity, both Clippy lanes, no LEAK, review provenance, and merge/squash-safe proof truth.
lanes.defer_reason: Deferred until producer, typed finalize, immutable evidence, and fresh review exist; fail closed until current main ancestry, exact source and witnesses, commands, map parity, no-LEAK scan, and distinct review provenance are bound.

values.failure_policy: Fail closed on incomplete production wiring, unsafe listener/root/TLS, noncanonical frame, wrong identity/domain/polis/node/epoch/generation/prefix, replay/conflict/reorder, incomplete participant registry, partial quiesce without reconciled resume, stale certificate new work, synthetic or corrupt snapshot, activated-target discard, capacity/path/size/open-handle/residue drift, public-route access, evidence/source drift, or unresolved review findings.
